name: App EQ
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Bit-exact port of the app's built-in 10-band graphic EQ. Constant-Q biquad peaking filters at ISO octave centres (31 / 62 / 125 / 250 / 500 / 1k / 2k / 4k / 8k / 16k Hz), Q = 1.4. Same RBJ cookbook coefficients the host runs on save, so the plugin chain version produces identical output to the built-in.
